name: Breaker service-position proof

summary: Confirms that the drawout element has reached its defined service connection position.
description: Confirms that the drawout element has reached its defined service connection position. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Service-position limit contact” at the input and “Service-position status” at the output. Service position alone does not permit closing.
